description: Websites where your store and your competitors are listed: booking platforms, marketplaces, directories, review and comparison sites. Found by weekly public web search for each site's domain, phone numbers, public email, address and name; a listing counts as confirmed only when it shows that phone, email, domain or address, and every one comes with its link and the matched text. Also returns gaps and opportunities (platforms your competitors use and you don't, and relevant platforms none of you use yet) and recent changes. "Not found" means our searches did not find it, not that it does not exist.

category.description: Only platforms of this kind: ota_booking, marketplace, app_store, directory, review, comparison, classifieds, news, social, forum, coupon, reference or other. Omit for all.

domains.description: Competitor domains from your RivalSweeper account to compare, up to 6 (your own site is always included). Omit for the 6 competitors with the most confirmed listings.
